Overview

This feature service contains the Wildfire Development Permit Area for Peachland and supports planning and land use review related to wildfire risk considerations.

Feature Layer

  • Wildfire Development Permit Area: A polygon layer representing the mapped development permit area associated with wildfire management and development regulation in the district of Peachland. It supports municipal and regional planning workflows, permit review, and public-facing geographic reference for wildfire-related development requirements.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the district of Peachland area within the Regional District of Central Okanagan in British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Development permit and planning review
  • Wildfire risk-aware land use management
  • Municipal GIS reference for regulatory mapping
  • Community and staff access to wildfire-related planning boundaries

Source and Use Notes

Owned by District of Peachland, served up by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan shared under the RDCO open data license and related terms of use.
